$comment: Locked render parameters for the Still Here series. Changing anything here changes how every future episode looks or sounds - edit deliberately. Values marked PENDING need creator sign-off before the first automated run.

render.style_status: PENDING - UNRESOLVED, blocks rendering. Episodes 1-3 are in the 'watercolor' style; this value is 'Animation' (3D), which episode 4 used and which does not match them. Set this to the chosen house style and change style_status to CONFIRMED. See STYLE_DECISION.md.
render.style_note: Modern 3D feature animation - warm cinematic lighting, soft bokeh, expressive stylized characters.
render.image_model_note: Nano Banana Pro. Chosen for 'most consistent image quality' - character consistency across episodes matters more here than text rendering.
render.captions_note: On. Children's content and many viewers watch muted.
render.ratio_status: CONFIRMED 2026-07-25 - vertical, posts as a YouTube Short. Chosen for reach on a new channel.
render.duration_status: CONFIRMED 2026-07-25 as an interim value. The agreed go-forward length is 60s, but the current 80-credit balance cannot cover it alongside anything else - raise this to 60 once the daily credit pool refills. See COSTS.md.
